projection_contract.authority: The exact bound PDF is the sole human source and prevails over every field in this projection.
projection_contract.derivation: Machine-readable index and conservative visual transcription only.
non_effect: Does not create executable VM semantics.
Does not establish adoption, currentness, finality, or binding force.
Does not import later runtime, relation-envelope, dual-agency, L1, account, identity, or resource-grant concepts.
projection_contract.conflict_rule: If this projection conflicts with the exact bound PDF, the PDF controls and the projection is nonconforming.

projection_method.name: CONSERVATIVE_VISUAL_INDEX_WITH_EXACT_PDF_CAPTURE
steps: Bind the exact PDF byte sequence by SHA-256 and byte length.
Embed the exact PDF bytes as base64 for lossless reconstruction.
Render all pages at 144 DPI and bind each render by SHA-256 and pixel dimensions.
Visually transcribe only symbols, labels, relations, and diagrams present on the pages.
Record ambiguities instead of inventing missing semantics.

source_capture.reconstruction: Base64-decode content without transformation; the result must match source_binding.digest and byte_length.

projection_ambiguities.statement: The PDF declares no executable transition algorithm, timing rule, state storage rule, or validation procedure.
The relation ○(•) ≡ ⊙ is visually declared; the PDF does not define whether ○ is a function, boundary, operator, or purely topological enclosure.
The proper-containment relation 1D ⊂ 2D ⊂ 3D is declared without a carrier set, mapping, or construction procedure.
The indices k and k+1 and the renew glyph in [1ₖ ↻ 0ₖ₊₁] are not separately defined by the PDF.
The PDF shows nine form-resolution coordinates and r(f) ≡ s, but does not enumerate nine distinct state meanings or state-transition rules.
The closing thesis distinguishes presence from state but does not formalize the passage relation beyond the preceding visual grammar.

conformance_requirements.requirement: Decoded source_capture bytes equal source_binding.byte_length and source_binding.digest.
The decoded source is a six-page PDF with 1440 × 810 point pages.
Every declared page-render digest matches the declared render profile.
All page, glyph, matrix, and assertion references resolve.
No machine field is treated as stronger authority than the exact bound PDF.
